ai_use_disclosure: Codex implemented this configuration under the student's direction; results are recorded separately from planned settings.

pricing.policy: Uncached global standard rates; response and thinking tokens count as output. Missing usage is charged at the full reservation. Estimates are not billing statements.

information_boundary: Current PNG/status/ticks and, only in history mode, the last three permitted observation/action/intent records. No files, tools, source, maps, oracle routes, debug state or cross-episode memory.
failure_policy: Invalid output leaves the game unchanged and consumes a call; two consecutive invalid outputs stop. Provider failures/timeouts stop without advancing the game. No hidden policy substitution or provider retry.
